Intentional defensive masking. The step builds a base64 authorization header from GH_TOKEN, which GitHub does not mask on its own because it is a derived value, and masks it before the git push so it can never appear in a log. Nothing here disables workflow commands (no stop-commands) and no user-controlled text is echoed into the command; the value comes from the workflow token only.
